facts.claim: RJ Mitte's death at age 34 was confirmed by his representative
facts.note: CBS directly received confirmation. AP also reported confirmation by authorities and representatives.

facts.claim: The cause of death remains unspecified in the AP/CBS report, while TMZ reports suicide
facts.decision: Omit cause of death from public copy.

facts.claim: Walter Jr. built SaveWalterWhite.com to seek donations for his father’s cancer treatment
facts.note: The original AMC site loaded in the authenticated built-in browser after the initial navigation timeout. Its text describes lung cancer, the operation fund, medical bills, and helping his dad. Footer identifies AMC Network Entertainment LLC.

facts.claim: A comparable simple webpage could be built from one AI prompt and published in minutes
facts.note: Primary product documentation supports prompt-to-live-site workflows. This is a possibility, not a personally performed test or a claim about a fully configured donation service.

editorial: Short memorial with one sentence about the website and restrained grief emojis. No invented rewatching experience, source-blogger attribution, or public production notes.

media_integrity.visual_inspection: Real portrait in source photo viewer; no text overlay or watermark cropped.
